DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 32 s. 2022 April 26, 2022 DIR. JONATHAN PAUL M. LEUSEN, JR. Regional Director, DILG-Region 02 Regional Government Center, Carig Sur Tuguegarao City, Cagayan Dear RD Leusen, Jr.: This has reference to your letter dated January 19, 2022 relative to the letter of Mr. Joel P. Samaniego, Municipal Accountant of San Isidro, Isabela, seeking clarification on the salary and benefits of removed Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB) President and an Ex-Officio Sangguniang Bayan Member by virtue of a Provincial LnB Resolution. At the outset, may we note that we are not furnished a copy of the letter of Mr. Samaniego. Be that as it may, per your letter, LnB President Reynaldo G. Hope meted a penalty of removal as municipal LnB President finding him guilty of gross neglect of duty and culpable violation of Liga Constitution and By-Laws in Liga Administrative Case No. 2021-001. An appeal before the Regional LnB Board was timely filed. However, pending the resolution of his appeal, PB Hope is actively participating in SB sessions and thus receiving the salary and other emoluments attached to the position. Accordingly, the issue hinges on whether the order of removal has the same effect as that of suspension, where the latter is immediately executory. At the outset, may we note that the issue proffered herein appears to be internal to the LnB, as such we are of the view that the same should be addressed by the Liga National Executive Board (NEB). Relative thereto, attention is respectfully directed to Section 507 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (Republic Act No. 7160), thus: "Section 507. Constitution and By-laws of the Liga and the Leagues. — All other matters not herein otherwise provided for affecting the internal organization of the leagues of local government units shall be governed by their respective constitution and by-laws which are hereby made suppletory to the provision of this Chapter: Provided, That said Constitution and By-laws shall always conform to the provisions of the Constitution and existing laws." While you aptly observed that the existing LnB Constitution and By-Laws did not explicitly provide that removal order shall be executory pending appeal, it is our view that matters concerning the implementation of the provisions of the LnB's "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Constitution and By-Laws is within the jurisdiction of the NEB. In DILG Legal Opinion No. 2 series of 2016, dated 18 January 2016, we opined therein that: "[M]atters concerning the implementation of the provisions of the LnB's Constitution and By-Laws is within the jurisdiction of the NEB as the body vested with the power and duty to promulgate rules and regulations implementing the same and as the body vested with the powers Of control and supervision over all Liga officers and members on matters concerning the following: terms and tenure of office, vacancies and succession; and removal and suspension from office." (Emphasis supplied) Premised from the foregoing, it is respectfully suggested that herein letter-request of Mr. Samaniego be referred to the NEB for its appropriate action. Further, this is also in keeping with this Department's Memorandum Order No. 2012-02, which categorically provides: "xxx [A]ll concerned are hereby advised that the Department shall not act on queries of the following kinds, to wit: 2. 3. 4. Those containing facts that are justiciable in nature. Justiciable issues are those that require adjudication by the courts of law as to who between the opposing parties have the better right over a given controversy; Those presumptively valid acts, e.g., enacted ordinances, consummated acts that already the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concerned, and similar instances; Those that are litispendencia, or pending litigation, except when the court itself, requests for the opinion. Xxx Those that are cognizable by other agencies of the government." We hope to have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: INGAN Unders retary for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/jam Page 2 of 2
